hints.title: Even Product Invariant
hints.text: A subarray has an even product if and only if it contains at least one even element.

hints.title: Last Seen Even Index
hints.text: For an end index i, any subarray starting at or before the most recent even index contains an even number.

hints.title: Contribution Accumulation
hints.text: Track the index of the latest even number seen. For each index i, it contributes last_even + 1 valid subarrays.

hints.title: Latest Even Index Accumulator Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating valid left boundaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining products of all O(n^2) subarrays causes integer overflow and quadratic time limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models valid subarrays ending at index i as starting at or before the latest even number.
